faq.title: FAQ
faq.lede: Dúvidas mais comuns nos primeiros 15 minutos com o kit.

items.summary: Qual survey devo rodar primeiro?
items.answerHtml: Para consultoria séria, rode os 3 nessa ordem: Developer Survey anônimo, Learning Survey identificado, Assessment principal com liderança informada. Para um baseline rápido só para o board, rode apenas o Assessment principal. O agente @ai-maturity-assistant te guia na escolha.

items.summary: Os comandos /calculate-scores e /gap-analysis não aparecem ao digitar /
items.answerHtml: Copilot Chat precisa estar em modo Agent. Clique no dropdown ao lado do ícone do Copilot e escolha Agent. Se ainda não aparecer, recarregue a janela do VS Code com Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+P e Developer: Reload Window.

items.summary: Copilot Free funciona ou preciso de Pro / Business / Enterprise?
items.answerHtml: Skills custom funcionam no Free com limites de mensagens. Para o fluxo completo, com 61 perguntas, 5 PDFs e cross-survey, recomendamos Copilot Pro, Business ou Enterprise. Confirme com sua org se há restrições de skills custom em planos enterprise.

items.summary: Tem dados de exemplo para testar sem preencher tudo?
items.answerHtml: Sim. make demo gera os 5 PDFs v2 a partir do mock ilustrativo (Contoso Engineering, 14 respondentes) em output/demo/, sem mexer no seu responses.json. Para rodar o fluxo completo no mock, rode make init (copia o responses.v2.json.example) e depois /full-pipeline. Os 2 surveys também trazem respondentes mock.

items.summary: Como agrego respostas de múltiplos respondentes do Forms?
items.answerHtml: A skill /import-responses mantém cada respondente do Excel do Microsoft Forms, e as exportações do formulário offline são combinadas com make merge. O engine calcula a média agrupada por pergunta, os scores por persona e a flag de divergência entre respondentes. Mínimo recomendado: 3 respondentes por função no assessment principal, 5 no Developer Survey.

items.summary: Preciso instalar dependências Python?
items.answerHtml: Sim: jinja2, weasyprint e openpyxl, mais jsonschema (opcional, para o validador do framework). Rode make install-deps ou abra o repositório no dev container, que instala tudo. No macOS o WeasyPrint também precisa de brew install pango; no Linux ou WSL, dos pacotes libpango-1.0-0, libpangoft2-1.0-0, libharfbuzz-subset0 e fonts-dejavu-core.

items.summary: Posso customizar o branding dos PDFs?
items.answerHtml: O kit usa a identidade paulasilva-ms, com paleta Microsoft 4 cores. Para customizar, edite reports/scripts/branding.py com suas constantes e gere os PDFs de novo. Os templates Jinja2 em reports/templates/ consomem essas variáveis automaticamente.

items.summary: Como checo as respostas contra evidências?
items.answerHtml: Três checagens opcionais comparam as respostas com dados reais, sem mudar as notas: make scan-repos (configuração de IA versionada nos repositórios, para D4-Q4 e D4-Q5), make telemetry (métricas de uso do GitHub Copilot, para D4-Q1 e D9-Q1) e make dora (métricas DORA por serviço com baseline, para D9-Q2). A seção 2.2 do PDF de sumário mostra o resultado, e o guia de implementação lista como riscos as respostas acima da evidência.

items.summary: Como funciona a integração entre o assessment v2 e os surveys?
items.answerHtml: O resultado de cada survey alimenta o próximo: o Learning Survey gera um plano que o wizard auto-fill modo D usa para preencher 7 dos 11 campos do guia de implementação. O Developer Survey calcula maturidade real por dimensão, que pode ser comparada com a maturidade declarada pela liderança no PDF de sumário do assessment.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.lede: Most common questions in the first 15 minutes with the kit.

items.summary: Which survey should I run first?
items.answerHtml: For serious consulting, run all 3 in this order: Developer Survey anonymous, Learning Survey identified, then the main Assessment with informed leadership. For a quick board baseline, run only the main Assessment. The @ai-maturity-assistant agent guides the choice.

items.summary: The /calculate-scores and /gap-analysis commands do not appear when I type /
items.answerHtml: Copilot Chat needs to be in Agent mode. Click the dropdown next to the Copilot icon and pick Agent. If it still does not show, reload the VS Code window with Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+P and Developer: Reload Window.

items.summary: Does Copilot Free work or do I need Pro / Business / Enterprise?
items.answerHtml: Custom skills work on Free with message limits. For the full flow, with 61 questions, 5 PDFs, and cross-survey, we recommend Copilot Pro, Business, or Enterprise. Confirm with your org if there are restrictions on custom skills in enterprise plans.

items.summary: Is there sample data to test without filling everything in?
items.answerHtml: Yes. make demo renders the 5 v2 PDFs from the illustrative mock (Contoso Engineering, 14 respondents) into output/demo/ without touching your responses.json. To run the full flow on the mock, run make init (it copies responses.v2.json.example) and then /full-pipeline. Both surveys also ship with mock respondents.

items.summary: How do I aggregate multiple Forms respondents?
items.answerHtml: The /import-responses skill keeps each respondent from the Microsoft Forms Excel, and offline-form exports are combined with make merge. The engine then computes the pooled mean per question, the scores per persona and the respondent divergence flag. Recommended minimum: 3 respondents per role for the main assessment, 5 for the Developer Survey.

items.summary: Do I need to install Python dependencies?
items.answerHtml: Yes: jinja2, weasyprint, and openpyxl, plus jsonschema (optional, for the framework validator). Run make install-deps, or open the repository in the dev container, which installs everything. On macOS WeasyPrint also needs brew install pango; on Linux or WSL, the libpango-1.0-0, libpangoft2-1.0-0, libharfbuzz-subset0 and fonts-dejavu-core packages.

items.summary: Can I customize the PDF branding?
items.answerHtml: The kit uses the paulasilva-ms identity with the Microsoft 4-color palette. To customize, edit reports/scripts/branding.py with your constants and re-render. The Jinja2 templates in reports/templates/ consume these variables automatically.

items.summary: How do I check the answers against evidence?
items.answerHtml: Three optional checks compare the answers with real data and never change the scores: make scan-repos (AI configuration committed to the repositories, for D4-Q4 and D4-Q5), make telemetry (GitHub Copilot usage metrics, for D4-Q1 and D9-Q1) and make dora (per-service DORA metrics with a baseline, for D9-Q2). Section 2.2 of the summary PDF shows the result, and the implementation guide lists answers above the evidence as risks.

items.summary: How do the v2 assessment and the surveys work together?
items.answerHtml: Each survey output feeds the next: the Learning Survey generates a plan that the wizard auto-fill mode D uses to fill 7 of the 11 implementation guide fields. The Developer Survey computes real maturity per dimension, cross-checkable against leadership-declared maturity in the Assessment Summary PDF.

about.title: Who built this, and why.
paragraphs: I am Paula Silva, an AI-native software engineer and Global Developer Solutions Advisor. My work spans the full AI transformation journey, from application and legacy modernization to agentic architecture and platform engineering, helping enterprise teams adopt AI-assisted development at scale. GitHub Copilot is one tool in that practice, not the whole of it.

The AI Maturity Assessment Kit packages the assessment workflow into a client-run experience: the assessment and two companion surveys, auditable scoring, gap analysis, strategy recommendations, and executive reports that can be generated without waiting for a web platform.

It is designed to help leaders and developer teams build a shared view of maturity, training needs, governance gaps, and quick wins while keeping the process transparent, reproducible, and ready for client adaptation.
